description: Tag Pilot tracking-health check. Counts purchase events per transaction_id to find duplicated purchases (usually thank-you page reloads, or the same order sent by both browser and server tagging) and purchases with no transaction_id at all. Returns totals, the duplicate rate and the worst transaction IDs. Uses 3 runReport calls.

date_range.description: Default: last 28 full days (28daysAgo to yesterday).

name.description: Optional label; shows up as the "dateRange" column when you pass several ranges.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

top.description: How many duplicated transaction IDs to list. Default 20.

name: check_duplicate_transactions
title: Tag Pilot check: duplicate purchases
